description: Gefahrenhinweisbereich großflächige Senkungsgebiete is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltatlas.bayern.de. In the basin of Bad Reichenhall a large-scale reduction takes place (Starzmann 1979:114). The demarcation of this sinking area was carried out on the basis of the site plan contained in this publication and on the basis of geological and tectonic conditions. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Hazard warning area Large-scale reduction areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include UmweltAtlas, Grögern Weiher, Gips, gdiby, Hangbewegungen, Reichenhaller Becken. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
